WHAT: NextAuth Credentials provider that only exists when NODE_ENV !== 'production' — lets you sign in as a test user without Google OAuth credentials

HOW: Clicking 'Dev Login' button on /login page signs in as dev@localhost. The /api/identify route gives this user 9999 search credits in dev mode.

WHERE: auth.ts adds Credentials provider conditionally, app/login/page.tsx shows the dev button only in dev, /api/usage or relevant route sets devUser.searchesUsed = 0 / limit = 9999

GOTCHA: This does NOT exist in production builds — the providers array is typed to include Credentials only in dev, so production NextAuth config is unaffected

WHY: Google Cloud project OAuth credentials aren't set up yet — this bypasses the blocker for local development
